Coach's note, city athletics club, Saturday.
The selection list arrived this morning: Uma is in the state relay squad. Dolma is not. They have trained side by side for three years. Dolma hugged Uma first, loudly and fast, then went off to run extra laps nobody had set. I let her run. Afterwards she sat on the bench, untying and retying one shoe. I asked how she was. When Sharmila got married last month, I gave the best speech of the reception. I'm Nitin. We'd been best friends since Class 6.
